---
title: Get started
engine: knitr
---

DaggerML requires Python 3.11 or later. Install it, then create a project with
the CLI.

<!-- docs:pseudocode: reader installation command; the docs build must use the current repository environment rather than install a released package. -->
```bash
pip install daggerml
```

```{bash}
mkdir research-demo
cd research-demo
dml init
```

The commands remain in one shell block so `dml init` runs inside the new
`research-demo` directory. It creates `.dml/` there. The next page uses that
same project to create and query a live DAG.

Continue with [Create and query a DAG](start-here/create-and-query-dag.qmd),
then [DAGs, nodes, and results](use/concepts/dags-nodes-results.qmd). Use
`dml --help` and [the CLI reference](use/reference/cli.qmd) for generated
command details.
